nusmp.skill.book_demon_ice.description: The grimoire of Demon Ice Magic, a sinister frost that freezes anything, even shadows and light. Twelve pages: starter bolts, shards and a piercing lance; a frostbite wave, a soul-freezing bind, Shatter, a glacier wall, a glacier slide and Frost Body; the Blizzard zone; Absolute Zero; and the daily Eternal Winter. Every page slows and freezes what it touches, and Shatter breaks fully frozen foes for heavy damage. The heavy pages also hurt the spirit and break barriers. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_demon_ice.descripti: Grimoire magic: Demon Ice Magic, a sinister ice that slows, freezes and shatters. Its twelve pages cover ice bolts, shard volleys, a piercing lance, a frostbite cone, a soul-freezing bind, Shatter, a wall, a slide, an ice body, a blizzard zone, Absolute Zero and the daily Eternal Winter. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_stri: A bolt of black frost leaves the grimoire and runs through everything in its path. Deals 8 damage (scaled by EP) to each foe it pierces, slows them (Slowness II, 3 s) and adds about 1.5 s of freezing.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_shar: Seven splinters of cursed ice fan out faster than the eye can follow. Each shard deals 3.5 damage (scaled by EP), slows the target for 2 s and leaves a little frost on it; point blank, every shard lands.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_lanc: A lance of black ice pierces the world in one breath and ignores what stands in the way. Hits every foe in a 26 block line (up to 12) for 9 damage, slows them (Slowness III, 4 s), freezes them, applies Tensura Frost and bites the spirit; it breaks enemy barriers where it ends.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_wave: A wave of frost rolls out of the grimoire and nothing in front of you stays warm. In a 9 block cone it deals 8 damage, throws foes back, slows them (Slowness III, 5 s) and freezes them for about 2.5 s; up to 16 targets.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_soul: The cold reaches past flesh to the soul and shuts it in a block of ice. One foe within 18 blocks takes 6 damage and a spiritual wound, is stopped in ice for up to 3 s (hard control, 12 s shared lock, shortened on bosses), then the ice cracks for 8 more damage. Needs a target.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_shat: What is frozen is already broken, it only waits for a hand to finish it. Every fully frozen foe within 12 blocks (up to 10) takes 16 damage, thaws and is left fragile (Tensura Fragility, 4 s). Nothing happens, and nothing is spent, if no foe is frozen.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_wall: A wall of blue ice climbs out of the ground between you and the dark. Raises a wall 6 blocks wide and 4 high for 10 s; foes within 3.5 blocks of its foot are slowed (Slowness III, 4 s), frozen and shoved back.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_slid: The frost takes you, and for a breath you are only motion on ice. You dash up to 10 blocks, cutting through foes for 6 damage and slowing them; the frost left on your starting spot keeps slowing anyone who follows for 2 s.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_body: Your body turns to demon ice: hard, cold and unwelcoming. For 20 s you gain Resistance II and Absorption II, your melee hits deal +4 damage and chill the target, and anyone who strikes you is slowed and frozen.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_bliz: A blizzard that was never of this world howls at the point you name. For 7 s a 7 block storm cuts everything inside for 2.5 damage twice a second, keeps it slowed (Slowness IV) and frozen, and puts out fires; up to 24 targets.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_zero: The air around you stops moving. Everything within 9 blocks takes 14 damage, is slowed (Slowness V), frozen solid (stopped for up to 2.5 s when your control lock is free, bosses far shorter), hit with Tensura Frost and hurt in the soul, while barriers break; 3 s later the ice bursts for 10 more damage. Costs 35% of your magicules.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_wint: A winter that does not end settles on the land. For 15 s, 14 blocks around where you stand: each second every foe takes 4 damage, is slowed (Slowness IV) and frozen, loses fire, a little aura and any hostile magic in the zone breaks. Once per in-game day.
